note: Every line the app speaks outside a protocol step. Protocol lines live in src/protocols/corpus. tools/render_voice.py pre-renders all of both. Keep each line at or under 12 words, and spell numbers and letters the way they should be spoken.

lines.speaker: Put the call on speaker.
lines.someoneCalling: Good. Keep them on the line.
lines.micLost: I can't hear you during the call. Tap the screen instead.
lines.groundFallback: Keep doing compressions. Tell the dispatcher that.
lines.emsHere: Paramedics are here. Show them this screen.
lines.practiceStart: Practice. Push on a firm cushion, in time with me.
lines.offline: No signal. I still have everything I need.
lines.scanUnsure: I can't tell from the photo. Tell me what you see.
lines.groundFallbackGeneral: I'm not sure. Tell the dispatcher that.

confirm.cpr_adult: Not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.cpr_child: A child, not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.cpr_infant: A baby, not breathing. We'll do this together.
confirm.choking: Choking. I'll walk you through it.
confirm.choking_infant: A baby choking. I'll walk you through it.
confirm.stroke: Could be a stroke. Quick check.
confirm.recovery_position: Breathing but not awake. Let's protect the airway.
